name: Strata — native JSON server
description: Configure prepared Strata models, GPU layer/pipeline sharing, request slots, context/cache and memory. Strata documents layer/pipeline parallelism, not tensor parallelism. Device placement stays engine-native and unverified.

fields.label: Prepared model format
fields.description: Native model file or prepared pack directory. Create mode maps the selected catalog model path into the matching native argument.

fields.label: Native engine executable
fields.description: Usually strata.exe on Windows. Separate from the Python server interpreter. The registered native executable is used when this is blank.

fields.label: Model architecture / family
fields.description: Optional Strata architecture name for server/model behavior. Leave unset to retain its native default. This does not establish model compatibility.

fields.label: Working directory
fields.description: Blank uses the registered installation directory in Create mode.

fields.label: Tokenizer directory
fields.description: Prepared tokenizer directory containing vocab.json, merges.txt and token_type.json.

fields.label: Additional native arguments (JSON array)
fields.description: Optional argument tokens, for example ["--option", "value"]. Model path is added automatically in Create mode. Unknown imported tokens are retained.

fields.label: Native library directories (JSON array)
fields.description: DLL/shared-library search directories. Blank uses the registered build defaults in Create mode; imported values are preserved.

fields.label: GPU selection (Strata device numbers)
fields.description: One GPU or comma-separated GPUs, e.g. 0,2. Passed to Strata as entered; VisLlama does not verify placement or reinterpret these as llama.cpp CUDA ordinals.

fields.label: GPU order
fields.description: Use native setting for Strata ordering, or as_given to retain the entered order.

fields.label: Layer / pipeline split points
fields.description: auto, or the first layer on each later GPU, e.g. 18 or 16,32. These are boundaries, not layer counts. Requires several selected GPUs. Strata verifies compatibility.

fields.label: Use one GPU when the model fits
fields.description: Strata may use the first selected GPU alone with an automatic split when it fits.

fields.label: Concurrent request slots
fields.description: Requests decoded together; this is request batching, separate from GPU parallelism. Choosing this replaces imported --batch/--slots arguments in the generated configuration.

fields.label: Context size (tokens)
fields.description: Full model context limit, not the resident KV window.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: KV cache format
fields.description: Engine-native format, e.g. int8, q4_0 or k8v4 when supported. Leave blank for the build default.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Resident KV window (tokens)
fields.description: Size of the KV window kept resident. This is not the full context size.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: RoPE scaling
fields.description: Use a scaling mode supported by this model/build.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: RoPE scale factor
fields.description: Explicit scaling factor; the model and engine must support the selected context.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: VRAM reserve (MiB)
fields.description: Native engine reserve for other programs. Does not enable VisLlama Calculated planning.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Later GPUs VRAM reserve (MiB)
fields.description: Separate native reserve for later layer-split GPUs.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Keep experts in resident RAM
fields.description: Native resident expert-memory mode. Enabling it replaces an imported --mmap-experts flag in generated arguments.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Resident expert RAM budget (GiB)
fields.description: Native RAM budget for resident experts. This does not download or repack a model.
fields.source: Upstream Strata docs; installed native --help verifies flag support

fields.label: Elastic VRAM expert cache
fields.description: Allow Strata native elastic-cache behavior when supported by the model and engine.

fields.label: Elastic VRAM segment (MiB)
fields.description: Native segment size, applied when elastic VRAM is enabled.
